sets.title: CONTROL: Boundary precision probe - no docblock
sets.description: Control set for boundary_precision capability probe. Pristine ~120-token method without any docblock. Both carriers are byte-identical. Tests baseline boundary detection when no docblock is present.
sets.notes: K-29 CONTROL. Pristine carriers without docblock. Ground truth start_line at function keyword (no docblock offset).

capability_probe.pass_criterion: control_set PASSES all detectors; probe_set shows +4 line offset at tolerance 2, offset resolves at tolerance 6
capability_probe.fail_meaning: boundary_precision ABSENT - tool cannot correctly exclude leading docblocks from region boundaries

sets.title: PROBE: Boundary precision - 4-line docblock offset (boundary_precision)
sets.description: Probe set for boundary_precision capability. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B has a 4-line docblock before the function body. Ground truth EXCLUDES the docblock (start_line at function keyword). Tools that include leading docblocks in regions drift +4 lines — caught by line_tolerance 2 failing while line_tolerance 6 re-scores passes.
sets.notes: K-29 PROBE. Carrier B has 4-line docblock (CM-03 style=4line). Ground truth start_line at function (docblock excluded). Delta = +4 lines if tool includes docblock. Bench re-scores at tolerances 2, 4, 6 to compute offset.

capability_probe.pass_criterion: control_set PASSES all detectors; probe_set shows +4 line offset at tolerance 2, offset resolves at tolerance 6
capability_probe.fail_meaning: boundary_precision ABSENT - tool cannot correctly exclude leading docblocks from region boundaries
